panels.title: Element success rate, all history
panels.description: Spine is workflow_metrics with no join and no time filter, so all 429 rows contribute. Cross-table history is too sparse to put this on a time axis without losing 93% of it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.value->>'success')::boolean) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array'

SELECT count(*) AS elements, count(DISTINCT m.workflow_id) AS runs FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array'

panels.title: Elements needing a fallback
panels.description: fallback_depth above 0 means the primary locator strategy did not resolve.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.value->>'fallback_depth')::int > 0) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS fallback_pct FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array'

SELECT e.value->>'locator_approach' AS approach, count(*) AS elements, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) AS failed, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS failure_pct FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY elements DESC

SELECT e.value->>'element_tag' AS tag, count(*) AS elements, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) AS failed, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS failure_pct FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY failure_pct DESC

panels.title: Failure rate by element shape
panels.description: Which structural properties predict a miss — iframe nesting, collections, a usable id, usable text.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (e.value->>'is_in_iframe')::boolean AS in_iframe, (e.value->>'is_collection')::boolean AS is_collection, (e.value->>'has_id')::boolean AS has_id, (e.value->>'has_text_content')::boolean AS has_text, count(*) AS elements, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS failure_pct FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY failure_pct DESC

SELECT e.value->>'url_domain' AS domain, count(DISTINCT m.workflow_id) AS runs, count(*) AS elements, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (e.value->>'success')::boolean) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS failure_pct, round(avg((e.value->>'fallback_depth')::int), 2) AS avg_fallback_depth FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_array_elements(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') AS e WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'element_approach_metrics') = 'array' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY failure_pct DESC
